title: Parametric motion behaviour
slide_intent: Separate a recognizable shape from variable movement so personality can change without losing identity.
strategic_value: A shared parametric reveal can give Channel 4 different tonal treatments while preserving attribution.
demonstration: A green logo rotates and separates into blocks as three slider controls change beneath it; the graphic returns to a readable 4.
practical_value: Compare variations in the reveal while checking that the final silhouette remains identifiable.

content_islands.name: Parametric specimen
content_islands.spec: Keep the animated logo in the central black stage.

content_islands.name: Controls
content_islands.spec: Place three small sliders and the cursor below to expose adjustable behavior.

reference_purposes.Expression: The animation shows several block rotations and returns to the assembled mark.
reference_purposes.Application: The displayed sliders demonstrate a parameter-driven motion system.
reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram explains that parametric possibilities let channel brands express different tones with clear masterbrand attribution.

ingredient.name: Parametric 4 reveal
ingredient.application: Adjust the movement of the component blocks while resolving them into the 4.
ingredient.scope: Observed demonstration in the 2023 case study; slider names and production values are not supplied.
